mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS 3m_change < 0

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) signals economic distress that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5%

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 9.0% and employment declines (PAYEMS 3m_change < 0), the market anticipates worsening economic conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0% and PAYEMS 3m_change < 0

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST 3m_change > 0) signal a recovery in the housing market, which is a positive demand indicator, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST 3m_change > 0

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO 3m_change < 0) indicates economic contraction in the supply sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO 3m_change < 0

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) signals inflationary pressure that triggers monetary tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and unemployment exceeds 9.0%, the combination signals prolonged economic weakness with limited monetary policy room, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy accommodation during high unemployment
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 9.0%

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 3q_change < 0) indicates economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 3q_change < 0
